contract.name: pregate-headwise-rms

reference_source.scope: read-only formula inspection; independent JAX implementation; no remote code execution

contract.intervention: RMSNorm over P separately for each B,T,R,H readout after D skip, BEFORE silu gate and rank reduction; shared H,P learned weights; eps1e-5; geometric identity ramp2048; no residual/output cap
contract.gradient: full chain rule through internal RMS and ramp; no detached or straight-through gate
contract.optimizer: fresh Adam .9/.999 eps1e-8; joint stable clip1; Mamba-R32 LR3e-4 / pregate H,P weights LR1e-4; warmup256; no MLP adaptation or gains
contract.checkpoint: local128; remote2048 or120min and deadline; current+Adam+best parameters;4GB total/invocation default
contract.selection: source A64/B32/C64; A16 monitor before full ramp, A64 selects best ONLY at >=2048 fixed endpoints; B/C never select; source+last+best context/profile
contract.interpretation: single seed exploratory; A/B/C exposed; no superiority/plateau cause established; compare equal steps AND intervention strength; cross-session CPU/GPU rounding recorded

value.interpretation: One A window; isolated pre-gate normalization; no artificial residual bound or recurrence-trace claim
